# Sweetwater Technology

> Sweetwater Technology builds custom web applications, AI-driven workflow automation, and digital products for businesses. The company is based in Atlanta, Georgia and was founded by Clint Crowe.

## Services

- [Custom web application development](https://sweetwater.technology/services/custom-web-applications)
- [AI workflow automation](https://sweetwater.technology/services/ai-workflow-automation)
- [Mobile app development](https://sweetwater.technology/services/mobile-app-development)

## Products

- [Rekkrd product profile](https://sweetwater.technology/work/rekkrd): AI-native music collection software
- [LaneWise product profile](https://sweetwater.technology/work/lanewise): A quoting copilot for freight brokers
- [ATL Urban Farms product profile](https://sweetwater.technology/work/atl-urban-farms): Specialized live-plant e-commerce
